steps.say: GLOSSOPIA is an invented language studio where you design a new language and test whether others can learn it.
Click Create a new language to start.
Fill in a name, author, and sentence order. We'll call this Luma with subject-object-verb order.
Add a brief note about the feel you want.
Now click Suggest words with Nemotron to get AI-generated word forms verified by GLOSSOPIA's own language checker.
Nemotron returned three candidate sets. Each went through the same deterministic check as manual creation. Pick the first set to fill the word fields.
GLOSSOPIA's core is deterministic — the app checks every suggestion before you see it. The language now has accepted words in both orders.
